items.source: Return a GeneratedMethods being used by the registrations code.
items.translation: 返回一个被注册代码使用的GeneratedMethods。

items.source: Add an instance post processor method call to the registration code.
items.translation: 在注册代码中添加一个实例后置处理器方法调用。

items.source: Return the name of the class being used for registrations.
items.translation: 返回用于注册的类的名称。

items.source: methodReference - a reference to the post-process method to call. The referenced method must have a functional signature compatible with InstanceSupplier.andThen(ThrowingBiFunction).
items.translation: methodReference - 对要调用的后处理方法的引用。 引用的方法必须具有与InstanceSupplier.andThen(ThrowingBiFunction)兼容的功能签名。

items.source:
Interface that can be used to configure the code that will be generated to
perform registration of a single bean.
items.translation: 可用于配置生成用于注册单个 Bean 的代码的接口。
